traits.name: Swear Vengeance
traits.text: ⬲ Trigger A creature the zealot can see damages a follower of Asmodeus other than the zealot Effect The zealot gains the effect of a 1st-level true strike spell. If the zealot makes an attack roll against anyone other than the triggering creature, the true strike ends with no effect.

traits.name: Items
traits.text: composite shortbow (20 arrows), half plate, mace, steel shield (Hardness 5, HP 20, BT 10);

traits.name: Channel Smite
traits.text: ⬺ (divine, necromancy); The zealot expends a prepared harm spell and makes a melee Strike. Instead of the normal effect of the spell, its negative damage is added to the Strike's damage.

traits.name: Deadly Simplicity
traits.text: The zealot's mace deals 1d8 (1d8) damage instead of 1d6 (1d6).
